nodes.label: Pages Workflow
nodes.rationale: Graph is built locally; this workflow only deploys whatever is committed in graphify-out/ to GitHub Pages.

nodes.label: CI build job
nodes.rationale: No tag to derive a version from, so uses cmd/version.go's version suffixed with -ci.<sha> and verifies it is embedded in the binary.

nodes.label: CI Workflow
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the Release workflow (test, build, package, checksum) on every push and PR, stopping short of publishing a GitHub release.

nodes.label: CI security job (Trivy scan)
nodes.rationale: Scans dependencies, secrets and misconfigurations and uploads SARIF to GitHub code scanning.

nodes.label: CI test job (vet + race tests, OS matrix)
nodes.norm_label: ci test job (vet + race tests, os matrix)
nodes.rationale: Race detector needs cgo, which the Windows runner is not set up for, so Windows runs tests without -race.

nodes.label: Release validate-tag job (tag on main)
nodes.rationale: Only releases tags whose commit is reachable from origin/main; otherwise skips release.

nodes.label: wd commands (add, list, rm, show, open, ls, path, clean)
nodes.norm_label: wd commands (add, list, rm, show, open, ls, path, clean)

nodes.label: fzf warp point picker (wd with no args)
nodes.norm_label: fzf warp point picker (wd with no args)
nodes.rationale: If fzf is installed, bare wd opens a fuzzy finder; without fzf it prints help as before.

nodes.label: wd (warp directory)
nodes.rationale: Go rewrite of the zsh plugin: single binary install, cross-shell support (bash, zsh, PowerShell), speed.

nodes.label: Shell wrapper (wd init)
nodes.rationale: A child process cannot change the parent shell's directory; the wrapper passes wd's own commands through, and that command list is built at wd init time, so saved init output must be regenerated after upgrades.
